name: Pekahiah
overview: Pekahiah, son of Menahem, briefly reigned as king of Israel in Samaria, continuing in the sinful practices established by Jeroboam that led Israel away from the Lord. His reign lasted only two years before he was assassinated by Pekah, a captain in his army, who conspired with fifty men to kill him in the king's palace and then took his place as king. The record of Pekahiah's actions and reign is further detailed in the chronicles of Israel's kings, highlighting the instability and judgment upon Israel during this period.
